blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) said there are strong indications that gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang, who is facing charges in connection with the disappearance of several “sabungeros” (cockfighting enthusiasts), remains in the country.
